=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh: the mapfile pipeline inside security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail (the `tail -c … | if [ … ]; then LC_ALL=C sed '1s/^[^[:space:]]*/[cut]/'; else cat; fi | … | grep -vxF -f "${stderr_prompt_file}" | tail -n …` chain), and the matching :1307 invocation `${RENDERED_PROMPT_FILE}` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `[cut]` rewrite makes a partial rendered-prompt line unable to match the exact-match filter, allowing it into logs and provider classification.
  WHY: A >64 KiB stderr can have a rendered-prompt line cut at the boundary; the resulting fragment can produce a false provider value.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py: _SECURITY_AUDIT_PROMPT_ECHO_LINE definition (the module-level `next(generator for prompt_line in … if "Chief Security Officer" in prompt_line)`) | severity=NIT | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The module-level `next()` raises `StopIteration` if a future edit removes or rewrites the matching prompt line.
  WHY: The import-time failure prevents the test module from loading and drops its contract tests.
- TASK_GAP — Requirement: "Lines that echo the rendered prompt are dropped (`grep -vxF -f <rendered prompt>`)" (PR description checklist); "Lines that echo the rendered prompt are dropped." (agents.md §7); "`security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail <stderr-file> <prompt-file>` … drops blank lines and lines that exactly match a line of the rendered prompt (`grep -vxF -f`)" (docs/plans/issue-5785-security-audit-codex-stderr-tail-plan.md §"Implementation Steps" item 2). The Copilot inline review (entry[0] in pr_all_comments_context, on scripts/security_audit.sh line 161) explicitly identifies the cut-line rewrite as a regression of this invariant and proposes one of two fixes: drop the partial first line, or filter partial lines against prompt suffixes before preserving them; it also says to update the cut-line test/docs accordingly.
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh, security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail — the mapfile pipeline that combines `tail -c "${stderr_tail_read_bytes}"` with the `sed '1s/^[^[:space:]]*/[cut]/'` rewrite and the subsequent `grep -vxF -f "${stderr_prompt_file}"` filter, plus the plan/agents.md/changelog wording that currently promises prompt-echo lines are dropped.
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk rewrites the cut line back to a form that can still match the rendered prompt entry (e.g. by stripping the `[cut]` placeholder, by suffix-matching the cut line against the prompt lines, or by dropping the cut line outright). The shipped chain mutates the line before the filter runs and relies on the filter never matching it. The plan §"Why" paragraph for AD-6 only addresses the boundary-cut token escape, not the prompt-filter interaction. The existing `test_security_audit_codex_stderr_tail_cuts_partial_token_past_64_kib` uses `"sk-or-v1-" + "f" * 70000 + " HTTP Error 402: Payment Required\n"`, which is not a rendered-prompt line, so the test asserts `tail_payloads == ["[cut] HTTP Error 402: Payment Required"]` and passes whether or not the prompt filter is broken; no other test exercises the >64 KiB + rendered-prompt combination. The Copilot-requested "update the cut-line test/docs accordingly" is unaddressed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: File: scripts/security_audit.sh; Location: security_audit_mask_stderr_line, the `case "${secret_env_name}" in *TOKEN*|...|PAT|*_PAT|PAT_*|*_PAT_*)` branch. The bare `PAT` glob matches any env var name containing PAT as a substring, including `PATH` (PATH = P-A-T-H), `COMPATIBILITY`, `PATCHED`, `PATTERN`, etc. When the runner env sets PATH to a long, non-secret value (the typical case on GitHub Actions), any stderr line that happens to contain the literal PATH string gets silently rewritten to `[redacted]`, which can hide the actionable part of a Codex error (a missing binary path, for example). Suggested minimal fix: Anchor the `PAT` glob so it only fires when the name starts with or ends with PAT or sits between underscores. Drop the bare `PAT` alternative and add `*_PAT_*|_PAT|*_PAT` (already covered), and rely on the existing `_PAT` / `PAT_` / `*_PAT_*` arms for the GitHub PAT / GH_PAT / *GH_PAT* cases. About 3 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
